book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yesus nu ŋgarosu kitek tina
Mara 6 kugana le Yesus nu Petrus Yakobus le maib nuŋe Yohanus nane kilmba naneŋge ndo tabe suŋgo ande poŋginaig.
Ka taŋge nane keŋ ta mambilmba minnaig kande Yesus tuku ŋgarosu mbilka kisemba mayok kina. Nuŋe tumail pasi ki tuku kilŋa suk. Nu tuku tawi kauknu uge liŋnu ndo mayok kina.
Taŋana le Moses le Elia nale mayok ka Yesus ndoŋ pasata minnaik le nane kaŋgerkinaig.
Taŋamba Petrus nu ndek Yesus sana: Suŋgo, sine teŋge mineg te mayenu ndo. Ne woka le ye baibai keŋmba ande ne tuku ande Moses tuku ande Elia tuku patiki ŋga sana.

Petrus nu taŋamba saka minna le gau ande uge liŋnu ndo pro nane kainiŋgina le gau ta sinamŋge pasa ande mayok ka teŋenmba sakina: Ande te ye tuku Kiŋo. Ye nu tuku kume purmba nu tuku gare suŋgo tet. Tane nu tuku pasa ise mayewap ŋga sakina le
Petrus nane miŋge pasa ta ismba kuru kuru mayemba ndek kilke mbolŋge truk kinaig.
Taŋamba minnaig le Yesus nu pro nane kigreka saniŋgina: Tane kuru kuru ndakap. Tane tiŋgap ŋga saniŋgina le
nane tandeka mambilmba Yesus nuŋe ndo minna le kaŋgernaig.
Nane tiŋga Yesus ndoŋ luka ndek ka ndinŋge Yesus nu nane peuniŋmba saniŋgina: Ye Ndindo Katesek Taŋgo ye kummba maŋ tiŋgi le ndo tane wam kiŋatanu suk kaŋgeraig ta afu saniŋgap ŋgina.
Kile nuŋe dubiwanu taŋgo keŋ ta nu kusnanaig: Ndaŋam kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal nane Elia nu amboŋga prowa le ndo Kristus nu prowamŋgat ŋga sakade ŋginaig le
nu ndek nane saniŋgina: Son. Elia nu amboŋga prowa sulumba wam ŋakmba kuaneka kile-tidiŋgam tuku ta

ye tane teŋenmba satiŋget. Elia nu buk mayok kina le nane nu kila pile ndakinaig. Nane nu tumba naŋgine nzali dubimba ŋayo silinaig. Taŋamba ndo nane ye Ndindo Katesek Taŋgo mata ŋayo siliyamŋgaig ŋga saniŋgina le
nuŋe dubiwanu taŋgo pasa ta ismba nu Yohanus kule pisne tuku saniŋgina ta nane wamdus puluniŋgina.
Yesus nu kiŋo ande bukla ŋak wakeina
Nane keŋ ta Yesus ndoŋ maŋ luka ka maŋgur suŋgo ta tugum pronaig le taŋgo ande pro Yesus tugumŋge dagol tidroŋga nu sana:
O Suŋgo, ne ye tuku kiŋo sinanu tura. Zulbarek maŋau nu mbol prote le nu sinamanzer suŋgo ŋak minit. Maŋau taŋge nu tate le ait afu nu pa mbol ndekate. Ait afu nu kule sinamŋge ndekate.
Ye nu tumba naŋe dubinade taŋgo te tugum prowit ta nane nu wakeiwam fuguwaig ŋga sana.
Taŋakina le nu ndek sakina: Tane Kuate talamba ŋgamuŋgal son tugusek kugatok mbal tane ye piti seryade. Ye ait giganmba tane ndoŋ minamŋgit? Kiŋo ta tumba yalpe ŋgina.
Taŋakina le nane kiŋo ta tumba pronaig le nu bukla ŋayonu ta sawe likina le nu kiŋo ta kusremba kua kina le kiŋo ta mayekina.
Taŋamba Yesus nuŋe ndo minna le nuŋe dubiwanu taŋgo nane nu tugum promba kusnanaig: Ndaŋam sine bukla ta pitaiwe fuguwig ŋga kusnanaig le

nu ndek nane saŋgina: Tane ŋgamuŋgal son tugusek kugatok ta tuku. Ye siŋka satiŋget. Tane Kuate tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋgade maŋau ta mastet tiŋnu taŋaŋ fudiŋndo ndo minwa ta tane tabe te samba ne goka ka ma si kaye ŋga sawap ta nu taŋawamŋgat. Ŋgamuŋgal son maŋau tambi tane wam ŋakmba kaŋgerkam kumuŋ. [Ande nu nyamagaŋ pinka ndo Kuate yabaŋte sulumba nu bukla pitaikam kumuŋ.]
Yesus nu nuŋe kumam tuku sanu arna
Yesus nane Galilea ma tugu mbolŋge kine promba minmba nu nuŋe dubiwanu kuasmbi saniŋgina: Nane ye Ndindo Katesek Taŋgo tumba kilke mbol mbal tuku wai mbolŋge pilwaig le baleyamŋgaig.
Baleyuwaig le ye kumi sulumba mara keŋnu mbolŋge Kuate nu ye kuaneyuwa le tinuŋgit ŋga saniŋgina. Taŋakina le nane pasa ta ismba piti suŋgo ŋak minnaig.
Yesus nu takis ndametiŋ pankina

Yesus nane Kaperneum tumbraŋ pronaig le kusem wande suŋgo tuku ndametiŋ kilanu mbal pro Petrus kusnanaig: Tane tuku tum taŋgo nu kusem wande suŋgo tuku takis ndametiŋ patikate e ŋginaig le nu au ŋgina.

Taŋakina sulumba nu maŋ luka wande mbol kina le Yesus nu katesemba Petrus kusnana: Simon, kilke te mbolok gabat sugo nane ima tugumŋge takis ndametiŋ kilig? Nane naŋgine kiŋo kame tugumŋge kilig e ko mbal afu tugumŋge kilig ŋga Petrus kusnana le
nu ndek Yesus sana: Nane mbal afu tugumŋge kilig ŋgina. Taŋakina le nu Petrus sana: Ta tuku gabat suŋgo tuku kiŋo kame takis patinu tuku piti ta nane mbolŋge mine ndakate ta

sine kusem wande suŋgo ta tuku takis ndametiŋ pan ndakube ta nane afu gubra tubekaig. Ta tuku ne kule kualiŋ nzi mbol kumba kuku tilaiŋga kualegaŋ amboŋga tamŋgat ta miŋgenu kakerka takis ndametiŋ kumumbi kaŋgeramŋgat. Ndametiŋ ta tumba ye tuku takis naŋe turmba patika ŋga sana.
